en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town with a stone arch road bridge over a shallow river in the foreground. The bridge has simple masonry parapets and metal railings, with a couple of people standing at the near end. On the left stands a two‑story building with a steep tiled roof and several windows; behind it and across the river are closely packed houses with gabled roofs and dormer windows. In the background rise larger institutional‑looking buildings with ornate façades and towers, set against wooded hills and distant fields. Wooden utility poles with multiple ceramic insulators line the riverbank, suggesting early electrification. The scene has the composed, slightly elevated perspective typical of early 20th‑century town‑view postcards.
